technical.summary: LH shows bullish structure with price above all major MAs and positive momentum indicators, but extreme RSI(9) overbought condition combined with stochastic bearish cross and weak ADX trend strength create significant pullback risk unsuitable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: LH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 42 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Ro Khanna's consistent purchases show conviction but lack seniority; broad market fear (AAII 42% bearish, Fear/Greed 46) presents contrarian opportunity, though absence of recent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 219.5 crisis regime, imminent NFP event) creates severe near-term headwinds; earnings in 42 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Contrarian opportunity in fear-zone environment (AAII 42% bearish, Fear/Greed 46) with congressional conviction buying and price structure above major moving averages suggests potential reversal setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI(9) overbought at 83.5 with active stochastic bearish cross, weak ADX trend strength (18.45), macro crisis regime (inverted yield curve, VIX spike), earnings binary risk in 42 days, and zero fundamental/smart money support create overwhelming pullback and downside risk unsuitable for entry.

decision.entry_rationale: No entry warranted. Extreme RSI overbought (83.5) with stochastic bearish cross and weak trend strength (ADX 18.45) create imminent pullback risk; macro crisis regime (inverted yield curve, VIX spike) and zero smart money/fundamental support eliminate conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme overbought condition combined with macro stress and earnings binary risk in 42 days creates high probability of sharp pullback or gap down, with weak technical trend strength unable to sustain momentum.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical, fundamental, and risk agents all score low conviction; only sentiment offers mild contrarian offset insufficient to override macro and technical headwinds
